app.academy.settings.general.keybindings: Open Keybindings to change controls. Changes are saved immediately.
tooltip.academy.dark_matter_radial: Press [I] to bind a PSI spell
skill.academy.darkmatter_six_wings.desc: Reserve computing power to gain flight and amplify Dark Matter Cut and Disassemble.
skill.academy.darkmatter_creation.desc: Summon up to eight owned beetles; look at one and cast again to dismiss it.
skill.academy.darkmatter_radiation.desc: Hold to irradiate hostile targets in the forward hemisphere within 32 blocks.
skill.academy.darkmatter_repair.desc: Toggle continuous self-repair that consumes computing power only while restoring health.
skill.academy.darkmatter_cut.desc: Release a dark-matter slash that damages hostile targets in an eight-block forward cone.
skill.academy.darkmatter_shaping.desc: Create dark matter with an empty hand, or repair and toggle dark-matter reinforcement on the held item.
skill.academy.darkmatter_disassemble.des: Disassemble a server-selected target or permitted block within 32 blocks.
death.attack.academy.quantum_collapse: %1$s's probability cloud spread to infinity, rendering local existence infinitesimal
skill.academy.airflow_jet.desc: Hold the skill key to continuously propel yourself along your line of sight; release to stop, or sneak to brake rapidly.
skill.academy.air_cushion.desc: Automatically cushion dangerous falls and protect nearby allies at high mastery.
skill.academy.flow_sense.desc: Sense moving entities and projectiles through line of sight and read their motion.
skill.academy.atmosphere_shield.desc: Maintain a compressed-air film that strengthens attacks and knockback.
skill.academy.breathing_film.desc: Maintain a thin layer of air that prevents oxygen loss underwater.
skill.academy.pneumatic_grasp.desc: Hold to pull or push items, experience, projectiles, and hostile mobs; maximum proficiency can affect other airborne living targets.
skill.academy.tailwind_field.desc: Maintain a personal current that accelerates allies and resists hostile movement.
skill.academy.laminar_cutter.desc: Fire a precise laminar blade that cuts targets and permitted soft blocks.
skill.academy.vortex_pull.desc: Create a rising vortex that draws entities, items, and projectiles into an airborne core.
skill.academy.atmosphere_blast_gun.desc: Release a wide air blast or charge a focused cannon; charge time is verified by the server.
skill.academy.wind_corridor.desc: Open a long-lived air corridor that transports allies, items, and projectiles.
skill.academy.pressure_lock.desc: Hold a visible target in place with server-authoritative pressure control.
skill.academy.flight.desc: Maintain an air current that grants controlled creative-style flight.
skill.academy.vacuum_domain.desc: Create a temporary vacuum that suffocates and damages hostile creatures.
skill.academy.atmospheric_dominion.desc: Command a broad atmosphere that protects allies, hinders enemies, and amplifies air skills.
skill.academy.electromagnetic_shield.des: Absorb incoming damage into an electromagnetic barrier that cools by consuming CP.
skill.academy.pulse_charge.desc: Hold the key to continuously charge the block, creature, and held or worn equipment in your sights. Computing power is consumed each tick only while a target is found.
skill.academy.current_symbiosis.desc: Continuously recharge the energy storage of your held and worn equipment.
skill.academy.bioelectric_operation.desc: Reserve computing power to drive your body electrically, improving movement, attacks, mining, jumping, and fall control.
skill.academy.magnet_manipulation.desc: Hold while aiming at an iron-bearing block or entity to pull yourself toward it. Hold Shift to pull the target in front of you.
skill.academy.mine_detect.desc: Reserve CP to reveal nearby ore blocks in already loaded chunks.
skill.academy.single_high_speed_electron: Fire a delayed electron beam that deals base damage plus one percent of the target's maximum health.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.desc: Charge and release seven delayed electron beams, each dealing base damage plus one percent of the target's maximum health.
skill.academy.radiation_intensify.desc: Electron-beam hits mark targets for ten seconds; later beam hits deal 50% more damage.
skill.academy.matter_warp.desc: Warp the server-selected point in sight, damaging and displacing nearby hostile targets.
skill.academy.threatening_teleport.desc: Teleport one held item into a living target within 24 blocks, dealing damage based on the item's attack bonus.
skill.academy.space_folding_theorem.desc: Increase compatible Teleport skill damage by 25%.
skill.academy.self_teleport.desc: Hold and scroll to preview a collision-safe destination up to 20 blocks away, then release to teleport.
skill.academy.flesh_ripping.desc: Hold to lock a living target within 14 blocks, then tear its space for 12 plus 5% maximum-health damage.
skill.academy.location_teleport.desc: Save up to 32 named locations and teleport safely between dimensions.
academy.location_teleport.name: Location name
skill.academy.quick_location_teleport.de: Send the entity under your crosshair, or yourself, to the selected saved location.
skill.academy.area_teleport_select.desc: Mark two server-raycast corners of a region up to 32 blocks on each axis.
skill.academy.area_teleport_setup.desc: Set the destination anchor for the selected region.
skill.academy.area_teleport_start.desc: Transactionally move the selected blocks, block entities, and non-player entities to the destination.
skill.academy.electrical_contact.desc: Reserve 15 CP to shock nearby enemies periodically and return an attributed electrical shock to hostile melee attackers.
skill.academy.vector_reduction.desc: Reserve 75 CP to create a spherical vector field that slows nearby entities and projectiles without accelerating targets outside its radius.
skill.academy.kinetic_energy_applied.des: Reserve computing power to strengthen movement and attacks. Left-click impacts entities or blocks, while an air swing releases the impact forward. Cycle strength from 1 to 6 and toggle block destruction separately.
skill.academy.dir_strike.desc: Drive a circular 12-block kinetic shock through the ground, damaging hostile targets and lifting nearby terrain as a render-only wave.
skill.academy.spatial_synergy.desc: Reserve 20 CP to carry nearby players along when you teleport, paying an additional cost for each passenger.
skill.academy.hyper_accelerate.desc: Charge a high-speed vector jump that repels and lightly damages nearby targets on launch.
skill.academy.magnet_moment_charge.desc: Launch a visible magnetic orb that persists for ten seconds and pulls nearby non-allied living targets toward its core.
skill.academy.thunder_lance.desc: Fire four lightning arcs from your hand, damaging targets along a 32-block path.
skill.academy.light_shield.desc: Hold to project a visible shield and gain Resistance II while periodic pulses repel and damage nearby hostile mobs.
skill.academy.mining_beam.desc: Hold to bore through breakable blocks and damage entities along a 48-block beam.
skill.academy.visual_teleport.desc: Teleport up to sixteen blocks along the server raycast to the nearest loaded collision-safe position.
academy.coordinate.invalid: The saved destination is unavailable or obstructed.
skill.academy.clip_through.desc: Phase a short server-derived distance through intervening blocks and land only at a loaded collision-safe position.
skill.academy.cut_through.desc: Hold and scroll to select a safe destination up to 36 blocks away, ignoring intervening blocks.
skill.academy.lightning_nova.desc: Release a visible expanding electrical ring that damages targets as the wavefront crosses them.
skill.academy.cloudroom.desc: Reserve 30 CP to reveal the recent movement of living entities within sixteen blocks using synchronized smoke trails.
skill.academy.beta_particle_stream.desc: Hold Alt+right mouse to charge up to five server-counted beta beams, then release an attributed spread attack with visible electrical trails.
skill.academy.jet_strike.desc: Dash toward a safe point eight blocks ahead and damage creatures around the destination.
skill.academy.particle_wave_cannon.desc: Hold to charge a wide 85-block beam that continuously destroys blocks and damages marked targets.
skill.academy.lightning_storm.desc: Call twenty-one visual lightning strikes around the server-raycast target, with each pulse attributed to the skill and scaled by ability damage.
skill.academy.ball_lightning.desc: Create a long-lived autonomous lightning orb with synchronized arc and core effects; it hunts nearby targets and detonates through the skill damage pipeline.
skill.academy.disarm.desc: Teleport the held item out of the server-selected target and deal attributed skill damage.
skill.academy.shackle.desc: Shackle the server-selected target with powerful movement and combat penalties while dealing skill damage.
skill.academy.phantom_falling.desc: Teleport a nearby hostile target upward, force it to fall, and apply movement and combat penalties.
skill.academy.iron_sand_arsenal.desc: Reserve 50 CP and cycle sword, whip, hammer, and shield forms; attacks use attributed scaled damage while the shield halves incoming damage.
skill.academy.magnetic_weapon.desc: Reserve 40 CP to orbit a magnetic weapon field that attacks the nearest visible enemy and blocks frontal projectiles.
skill.academy.thunderclap.desc: Call visual lightning onto a server-selected target and damage nearby creatures based on maximum health.
skill.academy.chain_fusion.desc: Launch a visible fusion core that chains through up to five non-allied targets with attributed, ability-scaled damage.
skill.academy.auto_cruise_beam_cannon.de: Reserve CP to scan a 16-block radius and automatically fire delayed electron beams at hostile targets.
skill.academy.disintegrate.desc: Fire a protected thirty-block disintegration ray that calculates damage independently for every entity on the path.
skill.academy.flash_back.desc: Toggle an automatic short safe blink away from incoming entity attacks.
skill.academy.flashing.desc: Reserve CP to dash eight blocks in a movement direction while the skill is enabled.
skill.academy.defensive_teleport.desc: Reserve CP to repel nearby hostile creatures and incoming projectiles to safe positions.
skill.academy.coordinate_teleport.desc: Store server-recorded positions across dimensions and teleport to the latest point after a calculation delay.
skill.academy.spacial_replace.desc: Select two server-raycast corners, then transactionally move a protected region of up to 32 blocks per axis to the looked-at destination.
skill.academy.spacial_excision.desc: Consume available CP to charge an expanding spatial excision that deals attributed damage and removes only blocks allowed by server protection rules.
skill.academy.vector_blast.desc: Project a 64-block vector blast that damages targets along its path. Crossing the Abyss adds an area of true damage ahead.
skill.academy.vector_reflection.desc: Maintain a bounded vector field that absorbs eligible incoming damage, reverses projectiles, and returns amplified damage to hostile attackers.
skill.academy.reflection_filter.desc: Configure which status effects may pass through Vector Reflection by mode, whitelist, and blacklist.
screen.academy.reflection_filter.title: Reflection Filter
screen.academy.reflection_filter.mode.al: Immune to every effect unless whitelisted.
screen.academy.reflection_filter.input_h: Separate effect IDs with commas or spaces (for example, minecraft:speed).
skill.academy.vector_accel.desc: Charge a server-authorized vector dash; longer charging increases speed and the trajectory preview shows the collision path.
skill.academy.storm_wing.desc: Reserve 20 CP to sustain vector flight; steer with movement keys and hold Space for the high-speed boost.
skill.academy.black_wing.desc: Upgrade Storm Wing into a two-wing vector flight form; normal attacks sweep a 32-block fan for true-health damage.
skill.academy.white_wing.desc: Upgrade Black Wing into its white form while retaining vector flight and the 32-block true-health fan attack.
skill.academy.platinum_wing.desc: Ascend beyond White Wing; normal attacks retain the true-health fan strike, while sneaking attacks execute a crosshair target up to 128 blocks away.
skill.academy.crossing_the_abyss.desc: Reserve 50 CP so your damage pressures true health, ratchets down the target's healing ceiling, and defeats targets that repeatedly survive lethal damage.
skill.academy.bloodflow_reverse.desc: Reverse a nearby target's blood flow, dealing biological damage and applying movement, attack, and mining penalties.
skill.academy.plasma_generation.desc: Gather a visible plasma core above the caster, then launch a server-targeted destructive blast after at least three seconds of charging.
skill.academy.arc_generate.desc: Release a short electrical arc that damages targets along a ten-block path.
skill.academy.railgun.desc: Charge and fire a destructive electromagnetic shot using a coin, iron ingot, iron block, or nearby thrown coin.
skill.academy.level0_passive_lv1.desc: Increase maximum CP by 20 and CP recovery by 1.
skill.academy.level0_passive_lv3.desc: Increase maximum CP by 100 and CP recovery by 5.
skill.academy.level0_passive_lv5.desc: Increase maximum CP by 500, CP recovery by 25, and calculation efficiency by 30%.
hud.academy.layout.hint: Long-press a box to grab it, then drag to move. Drag its corner handle to resize.
hud.academy.layout.title: HUD Layout Editor
hud.academy.mental_control.title: CONTROLLED TARGETS
skill.academy.mental_intervention.desc: Add the mob in sight to the controlled roster, or release it if it is already controlled.
skill.academy.target_misidentification.d: Permanently force every compatible controlled mob to mistake the selected living entity for an enemy; select it again to release the effect.
skill.academy.mental_stupor.desc: Toggle a lasting suppression of movement and actions for compatible controlled targets while reserving CP.
skill.academy.impression_manipulation.de: Suppress natural aggression in compatible controlled targets, allowing only self-defense, defense of their controller, and target misidentification while reserving CP.

message.academy.mentalout.unsupported_ta: That entity cannot be mentally controlled.
message.academy.mentalout.skill_unavaila: This skill is not currently available.
